items.question: Какая общая выручка по каждой категории товаров за всё время?
items.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
    1 - oi.discount / 100
  )) AS total_revenue
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories AS c
  ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE
  o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  c.name
LIMIT 100
items.answer: Общая выручка по категориям товаров за всё время: 'Ноутбуки' - 1 246 266 390.94 руб., 'Серверное оборудование' - 813 061 385.00 руб., 'Смартфоны' - 509 641 787.33 руб. Эти три категории обеспечивают более 70% общей выручки.

items.question: Какие 5 клиентов потратили больше всего денег? Выведи имя и сумму.

  SELECT
    cu.id AS customer_id,

items.question: Назови 3 категории с наименьшим количеством проданных единиц товара в выполненных заказах и это количество.

  SELECT
    id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    status = 'completed'
)

items.question: Каковы топ-3 категории товаров с наибольшим падением выручки во 2 квартале 2026 года по сравнению с первым? Покажи процент изменения.
items.sql:
WITH revenue_per_category AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', o.created_at) AS quarter,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount / 100
    )) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
  JOIN categories AS c
    ON p.category_id = c.id
  WHERE
    o.status = 'completed'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', o.created_at) IN ('2026-01-01', '2026-04-01')
  GROUP BY
    c.id,
    c.name,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', o.created_at)
)
SELECT
  r1.category_id,
  r1.category_name,
  (
    r2.revenue - r1.revenue
  ) / NULLIF(r1.revenue, 0) * 100.0 AS revenue_change_percentage
FROM revenue_per_category AS r1
JOIN revenue_per_category AS r2
  ON r1.category_id = r2.category_id
  AND r1.quarter = '2026-01-01'
  AND r2.quarter = '2026-04-01'
ORDER BY
  revenue_change_percentage ASC
LIMIT 3

items.question: Какой процент всей выручки приходится на три самые прибыльные по выручке категории вместе?
items.sql:
WITH top_categories AS (
  SELECT
    categories.name,
    SUM(
      order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (
        1 - order_items.discount / 100
      )
    ) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items
    ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
  JOIN products
    ON order_items.product_id = products.id
  JOIN categories
    ON products.category_id = categories.id
  WHERE
    orders.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY
    categories.name
  ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN categories.name IN (
        SELECT
          name
        FROM top_categories
      )
      THEN order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (
        1 - order_items.discount / 100
      )
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / NULLIF(
    SUM(
      order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (
        1 - order_items.discount / 100
      )
    ),
    0
  ) AS top_categories_percentage
FROM orders
JOIN order_items
  ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
JOIN products
  ON order_items.product_id = products.id
JOIN categories
  ON products.category_id = categories.id
WHERE
  orders.status = 'completed'
LIMIT 100
items.answer: Три самые прибыльные категории составляют 73.63% от всей выручки.
